markers.name: Ksnia Healing Spring
markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

markers.name: House of Lorochurov
markers.note: A merchant family of Sutesh, one of the richest in the land. Its factors buy and sell across the whole market, and a share of every deal ends in its coffers.

markers.name: House of Tuusmuksa
markers.note: A merchant family of Joen, one of the richest in the land. Its factors buy and sell across the whole market, and a share of every deal ends in its coffers.

markers.name: House of Piandino
markers.note: A merchant family of Celenaza, one of the richest in the land. Its factors buy and sell across the whole market, and a share of every deal ends in its coffers.

markers.name: The Pink Ox
markers.note: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious boiled chicken with cold whisky is served here.

markers.name: The Pink Wolverine

markers.name: The Hungry Tavern

markers.name: The Old Lark

markers.name: The Golden Snake

markers.name: The Favorable Tavern

markers.name: The White Sheep

markers.name: The Good Tiger

markers.name: The Amber Dog

markers.name: Vasetbo Tournament
markers.note: Warriors from around the land gather for a tournament of cunning in Vasetbo, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

markers.name: Sundurdur Fair
markers.note: A fair is being held in Sundurdur, offering local horses alongside foreign goods and services.

markers.name: Ortin Customs House
markers.note: A customs house of Ceria on the road from Beviles. Carts queue at its barrier while the wardens weigh their loads and collect the tariffs.

markers.name: Chail Customs House
markers.note: A customs house of Ceria on the road from Boes. Carts queue at its barrier while the wardens weigh their loads and collect the tariffs.

markers.name: Konich Customs House
markers.note: A customs house of Pronsia on the road from Beviles. Carts queue at its barrier while the wardens weigh their loads and collect the tariffs.

markers.name: Bygslika Customs House
markers.note: A customs house of Vasetbia on the road from Sangeyri. Carts queue at its barrier while the wardens weigh their loads and collect the tariffs.

markers.name: Escray Customs House
markers.note: A customs house of Loutargisia on the road from Boes. Carts queue at its barrier while the wardens weigh their loads and collect the tariffs.

markers.name: Minor Jetty
markers.note: A small location along the Stordi River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

markers.name: Scorpions migration
markers.note: A huge group of scorpions are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

markers.name: Diaphanous mirage
markers.note: This diaphanous mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

markers.name: Strennes Necropolis
markers.note: Rising from the desolate landscape, this sinister necropolis is a testament to necromantic power. Its skeletal spires cast ominous shadows, concealing forbidden knowledge and arcane secrets.

zones.name: Oyavik Invasion
zones.note: Troops of Oyavik have crossed into Kunsilia in the Oyavik-Kunsilian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: Beraian Invasion
zones.note: Troops of Beraia have crossed into Belovets in the Beraia-Belovetsian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

zones.name: Altanyayanese Tax Revolt
zones.note: Crushed by the taxes of Belovets, the people of Altanyayan refuse to pay and have taken up arms against the tax collectors.

zones.name: Celenazan Tax Rebels
zones.note: Crushed by the taxes of Cole, the people of Celenaza refuse to pay and have taken up arms against the tax collectors.

zones.name: Etmosian Renegades
zones.note: Etmosia has risen against the rule of Schildenia. Corrupt officials have turned the people against their rulers.

zones.name: Seibeirosism Proselytism
zones.note: Missionaries of Seibeirosism preach among the followers of Kortish Pantheon here, winning converts village by village.

zones.name: Furious Cough
zones.note: An outbreak of furious cough that began in the port of Anvilly, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: Vicious Cough
zones.note: An outbreak of vicious cough that began in the market of Eurao. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

zones.name: Nucillian Tornadoes
zones.note: Tornadoes have torn through the land around Nucillos, leaving a trail of wrecked farms.

zones.name: Borfinan Flood
zones.note: The Stordi river has burst its banks at Borfino, flooding the streets and the fields along it.

zones.name: Bambean Tsunami
zones.note: A great wave from the sea has struck this coast, wrecking harbors and drowning the villages along the shore.

zones.name: Pronsian Famine
zones.note: The poorest countryside of Pronsia. The harvest has failed, and its people have no money to buy grain from the markets, so they go hungry.
